recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血視野中散佈十個左右的顆粒性單核細胞，核圓至卵圓或輕度雙葉，胞質充滿深紫色異染性顆粒，部分顆粒稀少或散落周圍；循環中出現這麼多肥大細胞，符合肥大細胞白血病。
features: Numerous circulating granulated mononuclear cells scattered across a low-power field
Round to oval, occasionally bilobed or indented nuclei partly obscured by granules
Dark purple metachromatic cytoplasmic granules of variable density; some cells hypogranular
Granules dispersed around several cells, consistent with degranulation
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including occasional echinocytes, stomatocyte-like and elliptical forms
describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating granulated mononuclear cells with round to oval or bilobed nuclei and variably dense dark purple metachromatic granules, several with dispersed granules at the cell periphery. Some cells are hypogranular, a feature of atypical mast cells. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic mast cells, supporting mast cell leukemia (leukemic variant); confirmation by flow cytometry for CD117, CD25 and CD2, serum tryptase, marrow examination and KIT D816V testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei and are CD117-negative, and CML shows a left-shifted granulocytic series with BCR::ABL1.
Basophilic blasts are immature with nucleoli and lack tryptase and CD25 expression and KIT D816V.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: This entity may show atypical mast cells but is dominated by eosinophilia and defined by FIP1L1::PDGFRA on FISH or RT-PCR.
